name: Crushes & Curses
source:
As a novice mage cursed with lost memories, you can’t remember how to wield your magic. In search of answers, you find yourself at Tara’s Tavern.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
身为一名因诅咒而失去记忆的新手法师，你连如何施展自己的魔法都想不起来。为了寻找答案，你来到了塔拉酒馆。

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]]
